text: I wonder if my answers would be any different using a different open string, which tend to be mellower anyway, or a fingered note.
This sounded equal in dynamic to the intended pp dynamic.
The f dynamic was the quietest so far compared to pp and mf, but it should have been the loudest.
I would really love to hear more than just an open A for these tests.

Not to be too picky, but there are a lot of types of pp possibilities out there. This had a more ponticello (intentionally unfocused and airy) sound to it. If that's what you wanted, then it was great.
